source: BBR/v3 via Datafordeler GraphQL — live address-pick lookups (#26 follow-up)
note: buildings: flat [husnummer,year,renYear,wallCode,roofCode,heatCode,fuelCode]*N array. units: flat [adresseIdentificerer,areaM2]*N array. Both keyed by the exact UUIDs a DAWA adresser/autocomplete pick returns (adgangsadresseid for buildings, adresse.id for units) — confirmed live to match DAR's id_lokalId/husnummer exactly, so no BFE/EBR resolution is needed here (unlike data/bbr.json, which is BFE-keyed for listings). 0 means missing/not recorded; wall/roof/heat/fuel are raw BBR kodeliste codes.
